description: Internal header for BoringSSL's cryptographic random number generation, defining functions, macros, and structures related to entropy collection, RNG, and DRBG state management.

methods.name: RAND_bytes_with_additional_data
methods.description: Samples random bytes from RNG after mixing in user-provided additional data.

methods.name: CRYPTO_get_seed_entropy
methods.description: Obtains entropy suitable for seeding a DRBG, indicating if entropy came from CPU.

methods.name: RAND_load_entropy
methods.description: Feeds additional entropy into the RNG system.

methods.name: CRYPTO_sysrand
methods.description: Fills buffer with entropy from the operating system.

methods.name: CRYPTO_sysrand_for_seed
methods.description: Fills buffer with entropy for seeding, possibly from Android's /dev/urandom pool.

methods.name: CRYPTO_init_sysrand
methods.description: Initializes resources for system entropy collection.

methods.name: CRYPTO_sysrand_if_available
methods.description: Attempts to fill buffer with system entropy if available, non-blocking.

methods.name: rand_fork_unsafe_buffering_enabled
methods.description: Checks if fork-unsafe buffering is enabled.

methods.name: CTR_DRBG_init
methods.description: Initializes CTR_DRBG state with entropy and optional personalization.
